tldr: SpaceX 史上最大 IPO 掛牌首日大漲 19%、市值突破 2 兆美元躍居全美第六大企業，帶動全球太空概念股與台股太空 ETF 同步噴出。
美伊和平協議傳本週日簽署，將重開荷姆茲海峽並緩解能源供給疑慮，中東地緣風險可望降溫。
台灣 13 家金控前五月狂賺 3,674 億元、年增逾 1.3 倍，全年獲利上看 6,000 億元，公股金控超級股東會本週登場。
美國通膨壓力延燒，5 月躉售物價月增 1.1%、CPI 年增 4.2% 創三年新高，歐洲央行則自 2023 年來首度升息。
台灣擬調高未成年子女免稅額 50%，最快明年度適用，為家庭納稅人送上減稅紅包。

items.title_zh: 台股跌完又噴！狂飆千點重返 44K，集團作帳股吸金
items.title_en: Taiwan stocks roar back above 44,000 as funds rotate into year-end window-dressing plays
items.summary_zh: 歷經本週稍早的劇烈賣壓後，台股強勁反彈，單日狂飆逾千點重新站回 44,000 點關卡，凸顯在 SpaceX 上市、美國通膨數據與中東情勢牽動下，全球風險情緒大幅來回擺盪。法人趁季底前重新布局，市場點名 16 檔集團作帳概念股為買盤卡位標的。這波快速反彈顯示逢低買盤仍積極進場，但分析師提醒，指數後續仍易受美國科技股與 AI 晶片族群方向左右，波動風險未消，投資人宜留意量能是否續增以確認反彈延續性。
items.summary_en: After a brutal sell-off earlier in the week, the Taiex rebounded sharply, surging more than 1,000 points to reclaim the 44,000 level. The swing underscores how violently sentiment has whipsawed as global risk appetite gyrates around the SpaceX IPO, U.S. inflation data and Middle East tensions. Institutional investors are repositioning ahead of the quarter, with reports flagging 16 conglomerate-affiliated stocks as candidates for window-dressing buying. The rapid recovery suggests dip buyers remain active despite recent volatility, though traders caution that the index remains vulnerable to swings in U.S. tech and AI-chip leadership.

items.title_zh: 上市櫃公司 5 月營收創歷年同期最旺，法人建議優先布局績優股
items.title_en: Listed companies post strongest-ever May revenue, fueling stock-picking interest
items.summary_zh: 台灣上市櫃公司繳出歷年同期最強的 5 月營收，為大盤韌性提供堅實的獲利支撐。數據反映 AI 帶動的強勁需求與暢旺出口，券商建議投資人優先布局營收動能最明確的個股。在 AI 行情推升估值偏高之際，供應鏈全面的營收成長仍為多頭提供底氣。分析師指出，營收強勁主要集中在半導體、伺服器與零組件廠，這也使得進入第二季財報季前，強勢股與落後股的差距持續拉大，選股將比押注大盤方向更為關鍵。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's listed firms reported their best May sales on record for the same period, reinforcing the earnings backbone behind the market's resilience. The data reflects robust AI-driven demand and brisk exports, with brokerages urging investors to prioritize names showing the clearest revenue momentum. Strong top-line growth across the supply chain supports the bull case even as valuations look stretched after the AI rally. Analysts note that revenue strength concentrated in semiconductors, server and component makers continues to differentiate winners from laggards heading into the second-quarter earnings season.

items.title_zh: SpaceX 上市掀太空股狂歡，00910 單日噴漲逾 11% 站回 75 元
items.title_en: Space-themed ETF jumps over 11% as SpaceX listing ignites sector euphoria
items.summary_zh: 全台唯一太空衛星主題 ETF 第一金太空衛星（00910）單日大漲逾 11% 重返 75 元，市場資金在 SpaceX 美股掛牌前後湧入太空經濟族群。這波行情顯示重量級海外 IPO 能迅速外溢至本地主題型商品，吸引散戶追逐太空題材。投資人須留意，這類由動能驅動的急漲在 IPO 熱潮退去後可能快速反轉，且主題型 ETF 對仍具高度投機性的次產業曝險集中，追高風險不低，宜評估資金屬性與持有期間，避免在情緒高點重押單一題材。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's only satellite-themed ETF, the First Trust Space & Satellite fund (00910), soared more than 11% in a single session to reclaim NT$75, as money flooded into space-economy plays ahead of and around SpaceX's U.S. debut. The rally shows how a landmark overseas IPO can rapidly spill into local thematic products, drawing retail flows chasing the space narrative. Investors should weigh that such momentum-driven surges can reverse quickly once the IPO excitement fades, and that thematic ETFs carry concentrated exposure to a still-speculative segment.

items.title_zh: 百容半導體應用出貨續增，股價創 24 年新高、單週漲 25%
items.title_en: Pai Jung hits 24-year high as semiconductor orders accelerate
items.summary_zh: 連接器及零組件廠百容在半導體客戶積極下單、拉貨之下，本週股價大漲 25.12% 收 38.1 元，創 24 年新高。首季營收 4.81 億元、年增 14.15%，為七季以來單季新高，半導體業務占比已逾 50%。此波走勢顯示，受惠 AI 與半導體擴產的二線零組件供應商，正隨需求能見度提升而被市場重新評價。不過短線單週急漲幅度可觀，追高仍須謹慎，建議留意後續訂單與毛利能否同步改善，以判斷漲勢是否具基本面支撐，避免在消息面高點過度追價。
items.summary_en: Connector and component maker Pai Jung saw its shares jump 25% on the week to a 24-year high of NT$38.1, as semiconductor customers stepped up orders and pulled in shipments. First-quarter revenue reached NT$481 million, a seven-quarter high and up 14.15% year-on-year, with semiconductor business now exceeding 50% of sales. The surge illustrates how second-tier component suppliers tied to the AI and semiconductor build-out are being re-rated by the market as demand visibility improves, though such sharp single-week moves warrant caution on chasing strength.

items.title_zh: 台積電全台擴產！魏哲家喊台灣最重要，先進製程、CoWoS 布局全曝光
items.title_en: TSMC commits to nationwide expansion as Wei calls Taiwan its top priority
items.summary_zh: 台積電董事長魏哲家重申台灣仍是公司最重要的生產基地，並端出橫跨先進製程與 CoWoS 先進封裝的全台積極擴產計畫，當中包括吸引 7 座晶圓廠及供應鏈進駐屏東、打造新半導體重鎮。此舉展現對 AI 需求長期延續的信心。在地緣政治施壓分散產能之際，這項承諾鞏固了台灣在全球 AI 供應鏈的核心地位，並為全台多地帶來新一波投資與就業。市場關注擴產時程與用地、用電配套能否到位，將牽動供應鏈設備、廠務及在地相關概念股的中長期動能。
items.summary_en: TSMC Chairman C.C. Wei reaffirmed that Taiwan remains the chipmaker's most important production base, laying out an aggressive nationwide capacity buildout spanning advanced process nodes and CoWoS advanced packaging. The plan, which includes drawing seven fabs and their supply chains toward Pingtung as a potential new semiconductor hub, signals confidence in sustained AI-driven demand. The commitment matters because it anchors Taiwan's central role in the global AI supply chain amid geopolitical pressure to diversify production, while seeding fresh investment and jobs across multiple regions of the island.

items.title_zh: 下一波 AI 主線是它？PCB 女王看好光通訊、CPO、高階 PCB，點名 13 檔受惠股
items.title_en: 'PCB Queen' tips optical communications, CPO and high-end PCB as next AI mainline
items.summary_zh: 市場高度關注的 PCB 產業分析師「PCB 女王」點名光通訊、共同封裝光學（CPO）與高階 PCB 為 AI 硬體循環的下一個主流題材，並列出 13 檔潛在受惠股。此一觀點反映投資焦點正從 AI 伺服器與 GPU，逐步擴散至高速 AI 資料傳輸所需的連接與封裝環節。對供應鏈而言，頻寬需求攀升正推動 CPO 與先進 PCB 技術由利基走向主流，隨擴產加深，卡位相關環節的零組件廠有望被重新評價。投資人宜分辨題材熱度與實際出貨、認證進度，以免追逐尚未放量的概念股。
items.summary_en: A closely-followed PCB-sector analyst dubbed the "PCB Queen" identified optical communications, co-packaged optics (CPO) and high-end printed circuit boards as the next leadership theme in the AI hardware cycle, naming 13 potential beneficiary stocks. The call reflects how investor attention is broadening from AI servers and GPUs toward the connectivity and packaging layers that high-speed AI data movement requires. For the supply chain, rising bandwidth demands are pushing CPO and advanced PCB technologies from niche to mainstream, potentially re-rating component makers positioned in these segments as the build-out deepens.

items.title_zh: 蘋果新機再進化！三星 6 月啟動第 8.6 代 OLED 量產，MacBook Ultra 率先採用、Mini-LED 退場
items.title_en: Samsung to start Gen 8.6 OLED production in June; MacBook Ultra to debut panels as Mini-LED exits
items.summary_zh: 三星顯示器將於 6 月啟動 8.6 代 OLED 面板量產，蘋果 MacBook Ultra 預定率先採用，Mini-LED 則自產品線逐步退場。此轉變象徵筆電顯示技術的重要世代交替，OLED 的高對比與省電特性更受高階機種青睞。由於蘋果採用往往牽動產業方向，此舉對面板供應鏈影響深遠，將重塑上游材料與設備需求，同時迫使 Mini-LED 供應商轉向其他應用尋找出海口。台廠相關面板、背光與材料供應商的訂單版圖可能隨之調整，後續客戶導入時程與良率為觀察重點。
items.summary_en: Samsung Display is set to begin mass production of its 8.6-generation OLED panels in June, with Apple's MacBook Ultra slated to be the first adopter as Mini-LED is phased out of the lineup. The shift marks a significant transition in notebook display technology, favoring OLED's contrast and power efficiency for premium devices. The move carries weight across the panel supply chain, as Apple's adoption typically sets an industry direction and reshapes demand for upstream materials and equipment, while pressuring Mini-LED suppliers to pivot toward other applications.

items.title_zh: 貿聯砸 8.5 億美元跨國併購，強化 AI 資料中心布局
items.title_en: Bizlink-KY splashes $850 million on cross-border M&A to bolster AI data-center reach
items.summary_zh: 貿聯-KY 宣布以 8.5 億美元收購 Interplex Datacom，強化 AI 資料中心（AIDC）布局，為本週台廠規模最大的併購案之一。此收購深化貿聯對高成長 AI 基礎建設的曝險，擴大其在資料中心連接領域的產品線與客戶基礎。此案反映台灣零組件廠正運用併購快速切入 AI 相關利基，而非僅靠內生成長；在雲端巨頭持續擴大資料中心投資下，連接供應鏈的整併料將延續。投資人可留意併購綜效實現時程、商譽與財務槓桿變化，以及整合後是否能順利切入大客戶供應鏈，作為評估中長期效益的依據。
items.summary_en: Bizlink-KY announced an US$850 million acquisition of Interplex Datacom to strengthen its AI data-center (AIDC) positioning, one of the week's largest Taiwanese corporate deals. The purchase deepens Bizlink's exposure to the high-growth AI infrastructure buildout, expanding its product portfolio and customer base in data-center connectivity. The deal reflects how Taiwanese component makers are using M&A to scale rapidly into AI-related niches rather than relying solely on organic growth, and signals continued consolidation in the connectivity supply chain as hyperscalers ramp data-center spending.

items.title_zh: 台股牛市發威！13 家金控前 5 月狂賺 3,674 億元，5 家獲利翻倍
items.title_en: Taiwan's 13 financial holdings rake in record NT$367.4 billion in five months as bull market roars
items.summary_zh: 台灣上市金控繳出亮眼成績，2026 年前五月合計大賺 3,674 億元，其中 5 家獲利較去年同期翻倍。獲利暴增主要受惠 AI 帶動的台股牛市、暢旺出口，以及銀行、壽險與證券子公司投資績效全面爆發。數據凸顯熱絡資本市場正直接挹注金融業獲利，墊高股利分派預期，也牽動即將登場股東會的議程焦點。不過這類對市場高度敏感的獲利能否延續，仍取決於後市波動是否加劇，投資人宜留意壽險評價損益與股債波動對單月獲利的影響，避免僅以累計數字外推全年表現。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's listed financial holding companies posted blockbuster results, earning a combined NT$367.4 billion in the first five months of 2026 with five of them doubling profits year-on-year. The surge was driven by the AI-fueled equity bull market, robust exports and strong investment performance across banking, life-insurance and securities subsidiaries. The numbers underscore how buoyant capital markets are flowing directly into financial-sector earnings, setting up generous dividend expectations and shaping the agenda at the upcoming shareholder meetings, even as investors weigh how durable these market-sensitive gains will prove if volatility persists.

items.title_zh: 四家公股金控 18 日開股東會，股利政策、董事改選、營運計畫受矚目
items.title_en: Four state-run financial holdings hold AGMs June 18 with dividends, board elections in focus
items.summary_zh: 金融業超級股東會 18 日登場，公股四大金控兆豐金、第一金、華南金及合庫金同日召開股東常會。受惠去年全球貨幣政策轉向、AI 創新應用大爆發以及國內外需同步擴張，四家公股金控去年均繳出亮眼成績。由於公股機構受社會大眾高度關注，投資人將緊盯其股利政策、董事改選與營運計畫。這些股東會也是觀察公股銀行如何在股東回報與資本需求間取得平衡、邁向 2026 年的重要指標。市場尤其關注公股金控在股息配發與資本適足要求間的取捨，以及高層人事是否牽動後續經營方向。
items.summary_en: The financial sector's "super shareholder-meeting" season opens June 18, with state-backed holdings Mega, First, Hua Nan and Taiwan Cooperative all convening annual general meetings the same day. Benefiting from last year's global monetary-policy pivot, the AI innovation boom and synchronized domestic and external demand, all four delivered strong 2025 results. Investors will scrutinize dividend policies, board re-elections and operating plans, given the outsized public-shareholding interest in these institutions. The meetings are a key gauge of how state-run banks intend to balance shareholder returns against capital needs heading into 2026.

items.title_zh: 金管會放寬證券交易輔助人得受託交易之有價證券範圍
items.title_en: FSC widens range of securities eligible for trading via securities-trading assistants
items.summary_zh: 金管會宣布放寬證券交易輔助人得受託交易的有價證券範圍，以滿足投資人日益多元的交易需求。此次鬆綁旨在改善市場可及性、容納更廣泛的商品組合，反映金管會持續推動交易基礎建設與通路架構現代化的政策方向。對券商與中介機構而言，此一變革可望擴大業務範疇與客戶接觸點，投資人也將取得更具彈性的交易管道，呼應主管機關深化資本市場參與的整體目標。後續可觀察相關配套規範與系統上線時程，以及券商在合規與風控下如何將新範圍轉化為實際業務與手續費收入動能。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's Financial Supervisory Commission announced it will broaden the range of securities that can be traded through securities-trading assistants, aiming to meet investors' increasingly diverse trading needs. The regulatory loosening is designed to improve market access and accommodate a wider product set, reflecting the FSC's ongoing push to modernize the trading infrastructure and channel architecture. For brokerages and intermediaries, the change could expand business scope and client touchpoints, while investors gain more flexible avenues to transact, supporting the regulator's broader goal of deepening capital-market participation.

items.title_zh: 金管會公布 115 年 4 月底本國銀行逾期放款情形
items.title_en: FSC releases April overdue-loan data for domestic banks
items.summary_zh: 金管會公布 2026 年 4 月底本國銀行逾期放款狀況，這是衡量銀行體系信用品質的例行但備受關注的指標。在美國利率偏高、能源帶動通膨與地緣風險仍存的波動總經背景下，此項揭露讓主管機關與投資人得以監測資產品質是否穩健。逾放比若維持平穩，將強化金融業韌性並支撐強勁獲利論述；一旦出現上升則預警潛在壓力浮現。該數據仍是評估銀行提存與資本適足的基礎依據，投資人可搭配備抵呆帳覆蓋率與放款結構變化綜合判讀，掌握銀行在景氣循環中的風險緩衝能力。
items.summary_en: The FSC published its end-April 2026 snapshot of non-performing loans at domestic banks, a routine but closely-watched gauge of credit quality across the banking system. The disclosure lets regulators and investors monitor whether asset quality is holding firm amid a still-volatile macro backdrop of elevated U.S. rates, energy-driven inflation and geopolitical risk. Stable overdue-loan ratios would reinforce the sector's resilience and support the strong earnings narrative, while any uptick would flag emerging stress; the data remains a foundational input for assessing banks' provisioning and capital adequacy.

items.title_zh: 股市洗三溫暖！大戶悄悄把錢搬到「這地方」等風起，利息相差 27 倍
items.title_en: High-net-worth investors park cash in high-yield deposits as market whipsaws, chasing rates up to 27x higher
items.summary_zh: 近期台股劇烈震盪，高資產投資人紛紛獲利了結或降低風險，將資金轉為現金戰備部位，等待下一次進場訊號。遠東商銀 Bankee 社群銀行成為熱門停泊點，主打新台幣活存年利率 1.435%、高利部位無上限，據稱利率最高達一般活存的 27 倍。此趨勢凸顯在不確定時期，財富客戶對閒置資金更重視流動性與收益，迫使銀行積極競爭存款，並重塑高資產資金在進出場之間的停泊去處。對財管而言，如何在客戶高現金部位期間提供兼具收益與彈性的停泊方案，並適時引導再配置，將是維繫 AUM 與手續費收入的關鍵。
items.summary_en: Amid wild swings in Taiwan stocks, affluent investors have been taking profits and de-risking, shifting capital into cash war-chests to await the next entry signal. Far Eastern International Bank's Bankee community-banking platform has become a popular parking spot, marketing an NT$ demand-deposit rate of 1.435% with no cap on the high-yield portion — a yield reportedly up to 27 times higher than conventional demand deposits. The trend highlights how wealth clients are prioritizing liquidity and yield on idle cash during uncertainty, pressuring banks to compete aggressively for deposits and reshaping where high-net-worth money rests between trades.

items.title_zh: 瘋搶太空夯股！富邦人壽獲配 SpaceX 普通股 5 萬股，斥資新台幣 2.1 億元
items.title_en: Fubon Life snaps up 50,000 SpaceX shares for NT$210 million, riding space-economy fever
items.summary_zh: 史上最大規模 IPO、馬斯克旗下 SpaceX 周五正式掛牌美股，富邦人壽獲配普通股 5 萬股、投資約新台幣 2.1 億元。SpaceX 首日股價大漲 19% 至 161.11 美元，市值突破 2.1 兆美元，躍居全美第六大上市公司。此次獲配展現台灣壽險業正將資金布局指標性的全球成長標的以提升投資報酬。對財富客戶而言，此舉透露機構對太空經濟曝險的興趣，但此類集中的主題押注具估值與波動風險，配置部位仍須審慎拿捏。財管在向客戶介紹相關題材時，宜搭配風險屬性與資產配置框架，避免在熱潮高點過度集中單一標的。
items.summary_en: Fubon Life secured an allocation of 50,000 SpaceX common shares, investing roughly NT$210 million, as the largest-ever IPO drew strong institutional demand. SpaceX debuted on the Nasdaq Friday, jumping 19% to US$161.11 and topping a US$2.1 trillion market cap to become the sixth-largest U.S. listed company. The allocation showcases how Taiwanese life insurers are deploying capital into marquee global growth names to enhance investment returns. For wealth clients, the move signals institutional appetite for space-economy exposure, though such concentrated thematic bets carry valuation and volatility risks that warrant careful portfolio sizing.

items.title_zh: 幫您看緊荷包！臨櫃關懷阻詐＋安養信託服務，臺銀奪樂齡金安獎第一名
items.title_en: Bank of Taiwan wins top elder-finance safety award for anti-fraud care and senior trust services
items.summary_zh: 超高齡社會來臨、金融詐騙手法翻新，守護長者資產成為重要課題。臺灣銀行在第二屆「樂齡金安獎」中以結合臨櫃關懷阻詐與安養信託服務脫穎而出，榮獲第一名。此一肯定凸顯信託架構與第一線把關，正成為高齡客戶財富保全的核心工具。對財富管理實務而言，安養信託在傳承與資產保護規劃中的地位日益關鍵，提供受監理的框架以守護弱勢客戶，同時深化長期銀行關係。財管團隊可將安養信託與保險、預立醫療與監護規劃整合，打造完整的高齡資產照護方案，回應人口結構變遷下的財富傳承新需求。
items.summary_en: As Taiwan enters a super-aged society and financial scams grow more sophisticated, protecting elderly assets has become a critical challenge. Bank of Taiwan took first place in the second "Elder Finance Safety Award," recognized for combining over-the-counter customer care that intercepts fraud with senior-care (安養) trust services. The win highlights how trust structures and frontline vigilance are emerging as core wealth-protection tools for aging clients. For wealth-management practice, senior-care trusts are increasingly central to succession and asset-protection planning, offering a regulated framework to safeguard vulnerable clients while deepening long-term banking relationships.

items.title_zh: 金管會呼籲消費者勿購買未經主管機關核准之境外保險商品
items.title_en: FSC warns consumers against buying unapproved offshore insurance products
items.summary_zh: 金管會發布提醒，呼籲消費者勿購買未經主管機關核准的境外保險商品。公告警示，此類未經核准商品不在台灣監理保護範圍內，保戶將面臨理賠、清償能力與爭議處理等風險，且求償管道有限。此提醒對受海外保險商品吸引的高資產與跨境客戶尤其重要。對財富管理實務而言，這凸顯應引導高資產客戶選擇合法核准商品，並明確揭示未經核准境外保單在合規與保障上的缺口。財管人員在規劃跨境保險與傳承架構時，宜優先採用合法通路商品，並就法遵與保戶權益向客戶充分說明，避免衍生法律與聲譽風險。
items.summary_en: The Financial Supervisory Commission issued a reminder urging consumers not to purchase offshore insurance products that have not been approved by the competent authority. The advisory warns that such unauthorized products fall outside Taiwan's regulatory protection, leaving policyholders exposed to claims-payment, solvency and dispute risks with little recourse. The reminder is especially relevant for high-net-worth and cross-border clients tempted by overseas insurance offerings. For wealth-management practice, it underscores the need to steer affluent clients toward properly licensed products and to flag the compliance and protection gaps inherent in unapproved offshore policies.

items.title_zh: 減稅紅包來了！未成年子女免稅額擬增 50%，最快明年適用
items.title_en: Tax break incoming: dependent exemption for minor children to rise 50%, possibly from next year
items.summary_zh: 台灣擬推出減稅利多，將未成年受扶養子女的綜所稅免稅額調高 50%，最快明年度即可適用。此措施旨在減輕養育子女家庭的稅負，對有年幼受扶養親屬的家庭可望明顯降低課稅所得。此案契合政府支持家庭、因應人口壓力的整體政策方向。對納稅人與顧問而言，免稅額提高將重塑家庭稅務規劃，尤其對中所得家庭影響顯著，後續立法細節與生效時點值得密切關注。財管與稅務顧問可提前評估對客戶綜所稅試算與扶養親屬申報的影響，並結合保險、信託等工具，協助家庭客戶在新制下優化整體稅務與傳承安排。
items.summary_en: Taiwan is planning a tax sweetener that would raise the income-tax exemption for dependent minor children by 50%, with the change potentially taking effect as early as next year. The measure aims to ease the tax burden on families raising children and could meaningfully lower taxable income for households with young dependents. The proposal fits a broader policy emphasis on supporting families and addressing demographic pressures. For taxpayers and advisors, the higher exemption would reshape household tax planning, particularly for middle-income families, and bears watching as legislative details and the effective date are finalized.

items.title_zh: 買新車不到 1 年想改裝？車廂設備超過「這價格」未申報要補稅、加罰
items.title_en: Modify your new car within a year? Equipment over NT$15,000 must be declared or face commodity-tax penalty
items.summary_zh: 財政部台北國稅局表示，已課徵貨物稅的車輛，自領取新牌照登記日次日起 1 年內，如進行車身改裝或加裝設備，且貨物稅完稅價格在 1 萬 5,000 元以上，必須依規定申報繳納貨物稅。此規定針對新車領牌初期的改裝行為，避免透過領牌後升級規避稅負。車主若未申報，將面臨補稅並加罰。對打算在購車後不久進行後裝升級的買家而言，這是實務上重要的法遵提醒。建議消費者於改裝前先確認設備完稅價格是否達門檻，並保留相關單據主動申報，以免日後遭補稅加罰、增加額外負擔。
items.summary_en: Taipei National Taxation Bureau reminds that for vehicles on which commodity tax has already been levied, any modification to the body or added equipment within one year from the day after new-plate registration must be declared and have commodity tax paid — provided the taxable value of the equipment is NT$15,000 or more. The rule targets early-stage modifications after a new car is plated, preventing tax avoidance through post-registration upgrades. Owners who fail to declare risk back-taxes plus penalties, making this a practical compliance point for buyers planning aftermarket upgrades soon after purchase.

items.title_zh: 台灣中央銀行週四開會，利率、房市聚焦
items.title_en: Taiwan's central bank meets Thursday with rates and housing market in focus
items.summary_zh: 台灣央行週四召開季度理監事會議，市場高度關注其政策利率決議與對房市的態度。在全球利率偏高、能源帶動通膨壓力，以及 AI 出口熱潮支撐內需強勁的背景下，央行面臨在支持成長與抑制房市、物價風險間的微妙平衡。利率決議與會後說明將牽動市場對借貸成本、房貸條件及選擇性信用管制的預期。投資人與購屋族都將從央行措辭中尋找 2026 年下半年貨幣政策走向的線索。市場尤其關注央行是否再祭出針對性房市管制，以及對通膨與新台幣匯率的最新評估，這將左右債市殖利率與金融股後續表現。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's central bank holds its quarterly board meeting Thursday, with markets closely watching its policy-rate decision and stance on the property market. Against a backdrop of elevated global rates, energy-driven inflation pressures and a robust domestic economy buoyed by the AI export boom, the bank faces a delicate balancing act between supporting growth and containing housing and price risks. The decision and accompanying commentary will shape expectations for borrowing costs, mortgage conditions and selective credit controls. Investors and homebuyers alike will parse the bank's tone for signals on the direction of monetary policy through the rest of 2026.

items.title_zh: 加薪跑贏通膨！實質經常性薪資漲幅創六年新高
items.title_en: Real regular wages post strongest gain in six years as pay outpaces inflation
items.summary_zh: 主計總處發布最新薪資統計，剔除物價因素後，今年 1 至 4 月實質經常性薪資平均為 4 萬 4,115 元、年增 1.4%，創近六年同期最高漲幅；實質總薪資則達 26 萬餘元、年增 1.99%。數據顯示薪資成長終於跑贏通膨，有助支撐家庭購買力與消費。此一改善反映勞動市場吃緊與經濟韌性，惟各產業增幅仍不平均。對政策制定者而言，實質薪資持續成長是經濟擴張轉化為勞工實質所得改善的正面訊號。後續可觀察服務業基層薪資是否同步提升，以及加薪動能能否在物價波動下延續，以判斷內需消費的支撐力道。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's Directorate-General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics reported that, after stripping out price effects, average real regular wages in January-April reached NT$44,115, up 1.4% year-on-year — the largest gain for the same period in six years. Real total wages topped NT$260,000, rising 1.99%. The data signals that pay growth is finally outrunning inflation, supporting household purchasing power and consumption. The improvement reflects a tight labor market and resilient economy, though gains remain uneven across sectors. For policymakers, sustained real-wage growth is a positive sign that economic expansion is translating into tangible income improvements for workers.
items.body_zh:
國內加薪動能持續。主計總處12日發布最新薪資統計，在剔除物價因素後，今年1至4月實質經常性薪資平均為4萬4,115元，年增1.4%，創下近六年同期最高漲幅；實質總薪資則達26萬餘元，年增1.99%，更是近八年同期最高漲幅，顯示名目薪資的成長穩健贏過通膨。
主計總處國勢普查處副處長譚文玲表示，3月消費者物價指數（CPI）年增率為1.2％，4月略升至1.73％，雖數據微幅提高，但未出現劇烈漲幅；相較於美國通膨率已突破4％，國內情勢相對溫和，顯示行政院物價小組措施奏效，國內通膨情勢維持平穩，只要名目薪資成長幅度能持續大於物價增幅，實質薪資仍可望保持正成長。
譚文玲補充，去年1至4月CPI年增率平均為2.17％，今年同期則為1.35％，顯示物價壓力相較去年已有顯著改善。至於薪資的成長力道，包括最低工資的調升、廠商主動為員工加薪，或是各類薪資項目的結構性增加都有可能，只要整體薪資增幅高於物價上漲幅度，實質薪資就能夠維持正成長。
數據統計顯示，今年1至4月全體受僱員工經常性薪資平均為48,826元，年增2.77%；累計總薪資平均數28萬8,792元，年增3.37%。若單看4月當月，全體受僱員工經常性薪資平均數為49,146元，較上年同月增加2.9%，創下近27年來同月次高漲幅；若加計獎金及加班費等非經常性薪資，4月總薪資平均數達57,486元，年增3.6%。
在薪資中位數方面，今年1至4月全體受僱員工經常性薪資中位數為39,194元，較上年同期增加2.87%。若觀察4月單月，全體受僱員工經常性薪資中位數為39,348元，年增3.17%。
除了薪資數據亮眼，加班工時亦反映產業景氣復甦。今年1至4月製造業加班工時平均為17.6小時，創下22年來同期最高，年增0.9小時。其中，電子零組件業為28.8小時，電腦電子產品及光學製品業為16.8小時，均寫下近47年來同期最高紀錄。
若進一步觀察4月單月，製造業加班工時平均達18.5小時，為2010年8月以來最高點；其中，電子零組件業達29.6小時、電腦電子產品及光學製品業為18.1小時，紛紛創下該統計以來同期新高紀錄，相關數據亦呼應了近期的經濟成長表現。

items.title_zh: 台綜院擬上修 GDP 預估
items.title_en: Taiwan Institute of Economic Research set to raise GDP forecast
items.summary_zh: 台灣綜合研究院擬上修 GDP 成長預估，反映 AI 帶動出口暢旺與內需韌性帶來優於預期的經濟動能。此次上修將呼應市場一片樂觀的預測，近期金融業高層更在 AI 應用大爆發下喊出高達 10% 的成長估值。上修預估強化了 2026 年強勁擴張的論述，並支撐企業獲利與市場情緒，也為偏穩健的政策立場增添理據，儘管全球利率與地緣政治的外部風險仍在背景中徘徊。投資人可留意官方主計總處後續預測是否跟進上修，以及出口動能在高基期與全球需求變化下能否延續，作為研判全年經濟與企業獲利的依據。
items.summary_en: The Taiwan Institute of Economic Research (TIER) is poised to upgrade its GDP growth forecast, reflecting stronger-than-expected economic momentum driven by the AI-led export surge and resilient domestic demand. The upward revision would join a chorus of bullish projections, with financial-sector executives recently floating growth estimates as high as 10% on the back of booming AI applications. An upgraded forecast reinforces the narrative of a robust 2026 expansion and supports corporate earnings and market sentiment. It also strengthens the case for a steady-to-firm policy stance, even as external risks from global rates and geopolitics linger in the background.

items.title_zh: 5 月貿易順差優於預期，人民幣後續走勢有撐
items.title_en: May trade surplus beats expectations, lending support to the yuan
items.summary_zh: 中國大陸 5 月出口與貿易順差優於預期，加上經常帳盈餘維持高檔、企業結匯意願提升，為人民幣後續走勢提供支撐。在岸人民幣上週五收 6.7613，較前一交易日走升 157 基點或 0.23%，整週走升 96 基點或 0.14%。分析指出，穩健的對外帳戶為人民幣抵禦美元整體強勢提供緩衝。此數據反映區域貿易健康度與匯率動態，對在強美元、能源通膨環境下操作的台灣出口商與跨境投資人具參考意義。後續可觀察美元指數走勢、中國出口能否延續強勁，以及兩岸貿易結構變化對新台幣與相關產業匯兌損益的影響。
items.summary_en: Mainland China's May exports and trade surplus came in better than expected, with a high current-account surplus and rising corporate FX-conversion willingness providing support for the renminbi. The onshore yuan closed Friday at 6.7613, up 157 basis points or 0.23% on the day and 96 points or 0.14% firmer on the week. Analysts say the solid external accounts give the currency a cushion against broader dollar strength. The data offers a read on regional trade health and currency dynamics that matter for Taiwan exporters and cross-border investors navigating a strong-dollar, energy-inflation environment.

items.title_zh: 川普宣布美伊初步協議「週日」簽署！荷姆茲海峽將重開
items.title_en: U.S.-Iran interim deal set to be signed Sunday, reopening Strait of Hormuz
items.summary_zh: 美國總統川普表示，美伊臨時協議預計週日簽署，內容涉及重開荷姆茲海峽與遏制伊朗核計畫，但雙方在資金與核問題上仍存重大分歧。若協議落地，將緩解戰爭以來壓抑市場的能源供給疑慮與地緣風險溢價。美國、伊朗與巴基斯坦談判方均釋出數日內可望完成的訊號。此進展對油價、航運與全球風險情緒至關重要，惟以色列強調仍保留獨立軍事行動選項，後續履約與核問題第二階段談判仍是觀察重點。
items.summary_en: President Trump said an interim U.S.-Iran agreement is expected to be signed Sunday, covering the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz and curbs on Iran's nuclear program, though significant gaps remain over funding and nuclear issues. The potential accord would ease the energy-supply fears and geopolitical risk premium that have weighed on markets since the conflict began. Negotiators from the U.S., Iran and Pakistan signaled high odds of completion within days. The development is pivotal for oil prices, shipping, and global risk sentiment, though Israel has stressed it retains the option of independent military action.

items.title_zh: SK 海力士傳最快 8 月登陸那斯達克！募資上看 140 億美元
items.title_en: SK Hynix reportedly eyes August Nasdaq listing to raise up to $14 billion
items.summary_zh: 南韓記憶體晶片大廠 SK 海力士傳計畫最快 8 月於那斯達克掛牌，募資規模上看 140 億美元。受惠 AI 伺服器與 HBM 需求爆發，SK 海力士今年股價飆升 220%，市值突破 1 兆美元。此次赴美上市可望進一步擴大全球投資人基礎，並接續一波重塑晶片與 AI 版圖的大型 IPO 熱潮。此舉凸顯記憶體廠正把握 AI 基礎建設榮景，半導體領域對資金與投資人關注的競爭也隨之加劇。對台廠記憶體與 HBM 供應鏈而言，韓廠擴大募資與產能布局後續是否牽動供需與報價，值得持續追蹤。
items.summary_en: South Korean memory-chip giant SK Hynix is reportedly planning a Nasdaq listing as early as August, with a fundraising target of up to US$14 billion. Riding the explosion in AI-server and HBM demand, SK Hynix shares have soared 220% this year and its market cap has topped US$1 trillion. A U.S. listing would broaden its global investor base and follows a wave of mega-IPOs reshaping the chip and AI landscape. The move underscores how memory makers are capitalizing on the AI infrastructure boom and intensifying competition for capital and investor attention in the semiconductor space.

items.title_zh: 中國怒批美國將阿里巴巴、百度等列入軍事企業名單：將採取「強力反制」
items.title_en: China vows 'strong countermeasures' after U.S. adds Alibaba, Baidu to military-company list
items.summary_zh: 美國國防部將阿里巴巴、百度、蔚來、比亞迪及多家中國企業納入「中國軍事企業」名單，引發中國商務部強烈不滿。北京批評美方濫用國家安全概念打壓中國企業，並警告將採取堅決反制措施。此舉為中美貿易休兵後的雙邊關係再添摩擦，重新點燃在美上市中概科技股投資人的不確定性。此次升級顯示，儘管近期關係降溫，戰略科技競爭仍在進行，對供應鏈、資金流動與兩岸情緒都可能帶來連鎖影響。投資人宜留意美方後續制裁措施與中方反制力度，評估對相關供應鏈與台股科技族群的潛在外溢。
items.summary_en: The U.S. Department of Defense added Alibaba, Baidu, NIO, BYD and several other Chinese firms to its list of "Chinese military companies," drawing sharp rebuke from Beijing's Ministry of Commerce. China accused Washington of abusing national-security concepts to suppress Chinese enterprises and warned it would take firm countermeasures. The designation adds fresh friction to bilateral relations following a trade truce, reviving uncertainty for investors in U.S.-listed Chinese tech names. The escalation signals that strategic tech rivalry remains live despite recent de-escalation, with potential implications for supply chains, capital flows and cross-strait sentiment.

items.title_zh: Meta 祖克柏坦承 AI 轉型「出錯」！重申今年不再裁員
items.title_en: Meta's Zuckerberg admits AI transition 'missteps,' reaffirms no more layoffs this year
items.summary_zh: Meta 執行長祖克柏在內部備忘錄中坦承，公司在推動 AI 轉型與組織重整過程中犯下錯誤，但重申今年不會再進行全公司裁員。Meta 已將全年資本支出上調至 1,250 億至 1,450 億美元，並持續擴大 AI 投資與人才布局。此番坦率自省凸顯，即便資源雄厚的科技巨頭，在轉向 AI 時仍面臨執行挑戰。對投資人而言，飆升的資本支出凸顯 AI 領域正展開龐大的投資軍備競賽，在鞏固 AI 基礎建設與晶片需求的同時，也令人質疑其投資報酬。後續可觀察 Meta 資本支出回報、AI 產品變現進度，以及對整體 AI 算力與半導體供應鏈的需求拉動。
items.summary_en: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg acknowledged in an internal memo that the company made mistakes during its AI transition and organizational restructuring, but reaffirmed there would be no further company-wide layoffs this year. Meta has raised its full-year capital-expenditure guidance to US$125-145 billion and continues to expand AI investment and talent acquisition. The candid admission highlights the execution challenges even well-resourced tech giants face in pivoting to AI. For investors, the soaring capex underscores the enormous spending arms race underway in AI, raising questions about returns even as it cements demand for AI infrastructure and chips.

items.title_zh: AI 晶片股回檔該逃嗎？分析師點名輝達、博通與 Cerebras
items.title_en: AI-chip stocks pull back: analysts weigh in on Nvidia, Broadcom and Cerebras
items.summary_zh: AI 晶片股近期面臨獲利了結與估值疑慮衝擊，輝達、博通及 Cerebras 股價相繼回落。不過分析師認為長線題材仍完好：輝達仍掌握約 88% 資料中心 GPU 市場，博通 AI 晶片業務高速成長，獲 OpenAI 與 AWS 支持的 Cerebras 也具長期潛力。此波回檔反映市場在強勁漲勢後重新評估偏高的 AI 估值，而非基本面惡化。對投資人而言，這提醒即使結構上受惠的 AI 龍頭，在情緒與籌碼過度延伸時仍可能出現劇烈修正。布局上宜留意估值與獲利成長的匹配度，避免在高檔過度追價，並關注後續財報是否支撐高估值。
items.summary_en: AI-chip stocks have come under pressure from profit-taking and valuation concerns, with Nvidia, Broadcom and Cerebras shares all retreating. Still, analysts argue the long-term case remains intact: Nvidia commands roughly 88% of the data-center GPU market, Broadcom's AI-chip business is growing rapidly, and Cerebras — backed by OpenAI and AWS — retains strong potential. The pullback reflects a market reassessing stretched AI valuations after a powerful rally rather than a deterioration in fundamentals. For investors, the episode is a reminder that even structurally favored AI leaders can see sharp corrections when sentiment and positioning become overextended.
